title: Fault-injection tests
acceptance: Injected faults revoke only the intended authority and keep recovery access; benign input never trips it

effort.basis: Initial plan from the record's Check at featurePlans adoption; estimate, owner may revise. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one.
